title: Luna's Weird Craft
description: This is the current beta of Luna's Weird Craft using mods from all sorts of creators to give you a in depth experience that you couldn't even imagine of! Credits to all the mod creators and resource pack creators in this pack with all love and support!
body:
![Luna's Weird Craft!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db55ff642dc45cfa50ade6a4954e0db944b46acd.png)

This project is to raise money for autism awarness by donating to autism speaks! Find the donation link on the side!

Also show support for my friend whos streaming a lot so check out their twitch and discord!

[Chazza's Twitch (The Goat)](https://www.twitch.tv/bigboichazzaa)
  
  This project is to make a extensive use of my singular brain cell in making the weirdest but most enjoyable modpack I can physically create using my autism as inspiration! This pack includes things such as Farmer's Delight, Final Cut, Blockfish, Orbital Railgun, Night Dwellers, and the main view, Origins! Credits to all creators of the resource packs and mods in this mod pack with all the love in my heart!

  Thanks to the lovely testers that helped make sure the quality was medium rare for the pack!
  Boss9686
